matching: Exact existing S1 vocabulary type=1 strings for surface and ▁+surface only; retain missing spellings; no substring matching, tokenization decomposition or adaptive additions.
screen_matching: Same explicit surfaces, exact no-leading-space vocabulary strings only. Nonempty and disjoint target and partner sets required.
limitations: Ending pieces have lexical homographs. Some multi-token surface forms may be absent. This plan is independent of measured lens or screen outcomes.
